basis: Renal tubular salt wasting defines the disease, with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis in 9/9 and nephrocalcinosis in 7/8.
Bradykinin-mediated skin/oral angioedema; tongue swelling ~78%. [Series](https://doi.org/10.1111/all.13270). Episodic airway edema does not establish lasting lung damage.
Defined as metabolic skeletal-muscle disease associated with endocrine dysfunction.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss.
Progressive retinal photoreceptor degeneration; hearing annotations reflect syndromic forms and do not apply to most patients across this umbrella.
Congenital unilateral digital and metacarpal reduction; nail remnants accompany the absent or hypoplastic digits.
Lysosomal storage with defining dysostosis and ocular disease; intellectual disability/seizures ~80-99%. Hearing loss ~80-99% omitted by cap; hepatosplenomegaly <30%.
Defining heart, radial-ray/diaphragm and omphalocele defects; pulmonary hypoplasia commonly accompanies congenital diaphragmatic hernia (>30%).
DCX-related cortical malformation causes developmental impairment and epilepsy; contractures are secondary to motor impairment rather than direct skeletal disease.
Infectious abscess directly occupies and damages the cornea.
Mediastinal lymphoid malignancy; lymphoma warrants both blood-cell and immune axes. Mediastinal location alone does not establish lung disease.
Meningiomas arise in the meninges of the central nervous system.
Structural mitral leaflet abnormality, often with regurgitation; no common direct damage outside the cardiovascular axis.
Hair-follicle loss associated with hormonal signaling; includes androgenetic alopecia, so endocrine gland disease is not required across the group.
Interpreted as historical Cohen phenotype: developmental impairment, retinal dystrophy and neutropenia define it. [Norio](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7856650/).
Acute malignant proliferation of myeloid blood and marrow cells; FLT3 mutation does not establish another organ axis.
Inherited ocular refractive/growth disorder causing myopia.
Umbrella disease of the bronchi; infectious or immune mechanisms are not shared by all major subtypes.
Undifferentiated carcinoma of exocrine pancreatic origin; metastatic sites and endocrine dysfunction are not defining.
Strabismus 5/8; pes cavus 2/3 and toe syndactyly 1/3 support ocular/skeletal involvement. Hearing loss in only 1/1 is insufficient to establish population prevalence.
Inherited degeneration of retinal ganglion-cell axons and optic nerves; optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis. Extraocular disease is subtype-specific.
Alopecia and intellectual disability define it; hearing loss 80-99%, skeletal malformations 30-79%. Hypogonadism 30-79% omitted by four-axis cap.
Heart failure from rheumatic cardiac damage, an immune-mediated consequence of streptococcal infection; congestion does not establish direct extra-cardiac disease.
Disease of the pericardium; the umbrella includes inflammatory and noninflammatory causes.
Menstrual-cycle-related physical and psychological symptoms without defining damage to any of the 13 organ axes.
